name: tikz
description: Render ```tikz code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview with real pdflatex (Pandoc-compatible figure syntax).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: TikZ figures are compiled with pdflatex only in trusted workspaces.

tikz.preamble.files.markdownDescription: Files `\input` into the preview preamble, in order. `~`, `${workspaceFolder}` and paths relative to the workspace folder are accepted. Override in workspace settings to add project-specific `.sty` files.

tikz.preamble.extra.markdownDescription: Extra LaTeX appended to the preview preamble.

tikz.preamble.japanese.markdownDescription: Load `bxcjkjatype` so that Japanese text in figures compiles with pdflatex (needed by `font-ja.sty`).

tikz.preview.adaptToTheme.markdownDescription: Draw black as the preview text color and white as the background color, so figures follow dark themes.

tikz.preview.scale.markdownDescription: Display size of figures relative to their size in the PDF (1 = TeX points as CSS points). Figures never grow wider than the preview.

tikz.render.delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last edit of a figure before compiling it.

tikz.render.timeout.markdownDescription: Milliseconds after which a pdflatex run is killed.

tikz.render.concurrency.markdownDescription: Maximum number of figures compiled at the same time.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license -o dist/tikz.vsix
